reconcile.note: Gill treats Matthew's Galilee mountain meeting as a later, separate gathering from the same-day Jerusalem appearances, not a relocation of one scene.

discrepancy.note: Strauss argues Matthew's Galilee gathering rules out the same-day Jerusalem appearance that Luke narrates for the eleven.

quotes.text: This appearance before the apostles in Jerusalem however, as has been above remarked, according to Matthew could not have happened, since this Evangelist makes the eleven journey to Galilee in order to see Jesus.
quotes.attr: David Friedrich Strauss (d. 1874), The Life of Jesus Critically Examined, trans. George Eliot (1846), §138, on Matthew 28:16 and Luke 24:33.
